account: Yourcore is being developed as an outfit journal with an AI companion. Founder Christina Karaba publicly described building its website and developing the app with AI assistance in December 2025. The public site offers a beta signup and names Cori. A LinkedIn post dated 24 September 2026 reports that the founder presented yourcore at South Beach Yacht Club. That account describes an outfit-of-the-day journal with an AI companion and says that a beta cohort would start after LA Tech Week. These sources establish a developing product and its intended purpose. They do not establish improvements in users’ mental health, clothing purchases, cognition, or other downstream outcomes. No source reports use by beta testers or any results.

ai_role.statement: The founder reports using AI during product development. External accounts describe an AI companion, but do not independently document its runtime configuration or user effects.
